title: With Block Predictor
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robotics
description: Step through six short Python programs that use a fake robot arm and watch what happens to the error and to the torque. Then predict the outcome of each program before it is run. Used in Chapter 10.

educational.topic: try/finally, the with statement and context managers for hardware cleanup
learningObjectives: Infer the outcome of six short programs that use a fake arm, by choosing what happens to the error and to the torque, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict the outcome of a program and commit, then see the program run as an ordered list of events with the final torque and error state
keyQuestions: Which line runs the cleanup when the error is raised?
Does the error stop here, or does it continue upward?
commonMisconceptions: An error that is caught inside a with block leaves the torque on
Code after a failed call still runs
assessmentOpportunities: Six committed choices from four outcomes, one attempt each; 5 of 6 for mastery

controls.label: a / b / c / d (the four outcomes)
